title: B-1229.1 W1 — fixed PVC window in a rainscreen wall, B-side interface

facts.text: The CMHC-commissioned NRC client report describes four 2.44 m x 2.44 m laboratory wall specimens and compares paired base/variation window-interface details.

The report’s W1 uses a fixed PVC box-frame window (CSA A440 B7) in a wood-frame rainscreen wall with 19 mm clear cavity, hardboard siding, pressure-treated furring, 2x6 studs and spun-bonded polyolefin sheathing membrane. Its sloped subsill uses self-adhered bituminous membrane; B-side and V-side sealing differ at head/jamb.
